# 74S280 - 9-bit odd/even parity generator/checker

Package DIP-14 · family 74S · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74S280.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74S280.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 41 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74S280 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74S280.png) | ![74S280 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74S280.png) | ![74S280 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74S280.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 3 | NC | nc |  | no internal connection (lets it replace a '180) |
| 8 | A | input |  |  |
| 9 | B | input |  |  |
| 10 | C | input |  |  |
| 11 | D | input |  |  |
| 12 | E | input |  |  |
| 13 | F | input |  |  |
| 1 | G | input |  |  |
| 2 | H | input |  |  |
| 4 | I | input |  |  |
| 5 | SUM EVEN | output | totem-pole |  |
| 6 | SUM ODD | output | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | SUM EVEN = NOT (A XOR B XOR C XOR D XOR E XOR F XOR G XOR H XOR I) | High when an even number (0,2,4,6,8) of inputs A-I are high. |
| 6 | SUM ODD = A XOR B XOR C XOR D XOR E XOR F XOR G XOR H XOR I | High when an odd number (1,3,5,7,9) of inputs A-I are high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 20 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -1 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | SN74S280: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. Inputs are one 74S load (IIL -2 mA). |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 180 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| any data | SUM EVEN | PLH | 14 | 21 |
| any data | SUM EVEN | PHL | 11.5 | 18 |
| any data | SUM ODD | PLH | 14 | 21 |
| any data | SUM ODD | PHL | 11.5 | 18 |

## Not known

- No minimum propagation delays printed.
